_comment: expected values below are EXAMPLES for exercising bench.ts, not annotated ground truth. Nobody has run these through the live worker and recorded the real verdict yet — do that first (see docs/benchmark.md) before trusting any 'expected' field here. Descriptions are the page's own example chips (docs/index.html data-prompt values).

cases.description: A photolithography stepper with a 193 nm ArF light source for 300 mm wafers
answers: Minimum resolvable feature size (MRF) is 38 nm.
Exporting to the United States, for a civil semiconductor fab.

cases.description: A consumer drone with a 40 km control link and 8 kg payload
answers: Maximum take-off weight is 20 kg, endurance is 55 minutes.
No autonomous navigation beyond the operator's line of sight, no encrypted command link.
For sale to a hobbyist distributor in Germany.

cases.description: Standard e-commerce web software with TLS encryption
answers: It's an off-the-shelf storefront package using standard TLS 1.3 over HTTPS, no custom cryptography.
It is publicly available for anyone to download, no export restrictions applied by the vendor.
